summary.text: A 35-year-old postpartum woman, seven months after delivery and with a history of delayed postpartum hemorrhage requiring dilation and curettage, presented with malaise, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Laboratory evaluation showed acute kidney injury with creatinine 2.2 mg/dL, normocytic anemia with hemoglobin 8.4 g/dL, thrombocytopenia, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, low haptoglobin, elevated reticulocytes and a positive fecal occult blood test.

Later that day she developed sudden abdominal pain and hemorrhagic shock from splenic rupture, which necessitated splenic artery embolization, massive transfusion and dialysis. The smear showed schistocytes and the direct Coombs test was negative, the infectious workup was negative, C3 was low and ADAMTS13 mildly reduced without an inhibitor. CMV serologies and PCR were positive, raising concern for CMV-induced aHUS. She received brief plasmapheresis, a prednisone taper and valganciclovir, and hemoglobin and platelets normalized.

Four months later she presented with fatigue, upper respiratory symptoms and dark urine, with mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, COVID-19 positivity and negative CMV and EBV DNA. Bone marrow showed reactive changes, C3 was low and prednisone was started. A weakly positive repeat DAT consistent with warm AIHA, together with ITP, gave a diagnosis of Evans syndrome. Genetic testing found heterozygous CFH, CFHR1, CFHR3 and THBD findings of uncertain significance, with low alternative pathway activity and low factor H.

Her recurrent aHUS was presumed secondary to factor H deficiency. She had multiple glucocorticoid regimens with suboptimal response, then a four-week rituxan regimen, and a further admission treated with IV immunoglobulin, glucocorticoids and mycophenolate, to which she responded well. Mycophenolate 500 mg daily was continued. A later aHUS episode with anemia, thrombocytopenia and AKI required IV immunoglobulin and glucocorticoids, and IV eculizumab was started with a good response. She follows up monthly with hematology and has tolerated eculizumab for about nine months.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not classify the result as negative or positive; only the source word equivocal is recorded.

ambiguities.issue: Whether the recurrent aHUS was autoantibody-mediated is unclear and factor H deficiency is only presumed

evidence.quote: Her recurrent aHUS was presumed secondary to factor H deficiency; however, it was unclear if it was autoantibody-mediated.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not treat factor H deficiency as confirmed or infer an autoantibody mechanism.

ambiguities.issue: Mild anemia (Hb 10.5 g/dL) and worsening anemia are both listed for the later presentation, with no value given for the worsening

evidence.quote: Labs showed mild anemia (Hb 10.5 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (platelet 38K/μL), indirect hyperbilirubinemia, and worsening anemia.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not invent a lower hemoglobin value or a time frame for the worsening.

ambiguities.issue: Evans syndrome is stated as the combination of warm AIHA and ITP; no separate ITP workup or platelet antibody test is described

evidence.quote: The combination of warm AIHA and ITP yielded a diagnosis of ES.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not infer an ITP-specific test, and do not infer when ITP was diagnosed.

ambiguities.issue: Authors speculate that splenic rupture may have been an early manifestation of severe thrombocytopenia or vascular fragility in the context of complement dysregulation

evidence.quote: Splenic rupture may have been an early manifestation of severe thrombocytopenia or underlying vascular fragility in the context of complement dysregulation.

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not record vascular fragility or a causal link as a fact.

ambiguities.issue: Precipitating factors of the initial presentation are stated to be unclear, although CMV from children in day care is presumed as the source of CMV

evidence.quote: the precipitating factors that surround her initial presentation remain unclear
her children in day care were the presumed source

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not state a confirmed trigger for the initial presentation.

ambiguities.issue: Timing of the mildly elevated CMV viral load is only given as follow-up, with no interval

evidence.quote: CMV viral load remained mildly elevated at follow-up

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not assign a date or interval to the follow-up, and do not assume it preceded the second presentation.

ambiguities.issue: Splenic artery embolization, massive transfusion and dialysis are stated only as necessitated by the rupture; dilation and curettage and the IV immunoglobulin and glucocorticoids of the latest aHUS episode are stated only as required. No sentence says they were done

evidence.quote: hemorrhagic shock secondary to splenic rupture, necessitating splenic artery embolization, massive transfusion, and dialysis
requiring dilation and curettage
requiring IV immunoglobulin and glucocorticoids

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not record these procedures or drugs as completed or administered; action stays unknown. Do not infer dates, transfusion units or dialysis duration.

ambiguities.issue: Table values and text values were merged only where the text cites Table 1 or reports the analyte once at the labelled time point

evidence.quote: C3 (Complement) | 57 mg/dL (initial), 70 mg/dL (repeat) | 75 – 175 mg/dL
ADAMTS13 Activity | Mildly reduced ~60% (initial), 66% (later) | >67% (usually), severe deficiency <10%

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not treat the merges as proof that the table and text describe the same draw beyond the initial, repeat and later labels.

ambiguities.issue: Reference point of "Four months later" is not named: the preceding paragraph covers the initial presentation, treatment and follow-up; the anchor is taken as the initial presentation

evidence.quote: Four months later, she presented with fatigue, upper respiratory symptoms, and dark urine.
her initial presentation

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not order the second presentation against the follow-up CMV viral load, and do not compute a calendar interval.

ambiguities.issue: Immunocompetence is stated only as context for the unexplained CMV infection; no immunologic testing is described

evidence.quote: there was no clear explanation as to how this developed, given her immunocompetence

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not infer an immunologic workup or a specific excluded immunodeficiency.

ambiguities.issue: Mycophenolate was intermittently held due to elevated liver function testing or viral symptoms; the "or" does not establish that either reason occurred on its own

evidence.quote: It was intermittently held due to elevated liver function testing or viral symptoms

ambiguities.must_not_infer: Do not assert elevated liver function tests or viral symptoms as present findings; both items are review_only.
